verdict.rationale: Runpod ships an official, open-source CLI (runpodctl). It manages Pods, Serverless endpoints, templates, network volumes and models, handles file transfer and diagnostics, and has documented commands such as `runpodctl pod create`. The probe confirms the CLI documentation exists, and a separate Flash CLI (init and login) is also documented. Missing for 10: no independent or community hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and no evidence of AI-native-specific CLI features such as machine-readable/JSON output or agent-oriented usage.
